scope: Media design of 24 October 2026; no new released vocabulary type.

bindings.definition: One held or linked instantiation of a registered source.
Media.source_id names the record instantiated, never the person depicted.
Source.subjects names persons, places or events depicted or spoken of.
The holder's terms as written, without inferred permission.
Master width in display pixels, after orientation.
Master height in display pixels, after orientation.
An instantiation uses one of our four local RepresentationType concepts: image, audio, video, document.
Our page caption, with a separate human review.

mapping.reason: The application records caption language and review day/role; the pinned ontologies do not define that composite.

bindings.definition: Our screen-reader description, required for images, with a separate human review.

mapping.reason: Neither pinned ontology defines the application's accessibility text and its human review.

bindings.definition: Master duration in seconds.

mapping.reason: This design claims no pinned duration mapping; seconds remain a local display measurement.

bindings.definition: An applicable rightsstatements.org or Creative Commons URI.

mapping.reason: This URI identifies terms, not the owner's permission to publish this particular copy.

bindings.definition: Public clearance day and closed role; contributor identity and consent evidence are private.

mapping.reason: Rights and text review cannot stand for the owner's permission to derive or serve a private copy.

bindings.definition: A holder-host page for audio or video.

mapping.reason: This link is a referral to the holder's page, not a served media file or clearance.

bindings.definition: A separate private bucket name, content key, SHA-256, MIME, byte count and dated fixity check.

mapping.reason: Neither pinned ontology defines this application's content-addressed private storage descriptor; it never enters the public projection.

bindings.definition: Content-hashed WebP addresses, actual dimensions and the sole process resize at the exported widths.

mapping.reason: Neither pinned ontology defines this application's responsive WebP delivery manifest.

bindings.definition: The holder's access terms, verbatim.
The holder or family's credit, verbatim.

mapping.reason: IIIF requiredStatement is a future delivery crosswalk; no IIIF ontology is pinned here.

bindings.definition: Identified or unidentified people, human identification basis and master pixel regions.

mapping.reason: Source subjects use RiC-O; this per-picture identification and rectangle are application data.

bindings.definition: An explicit declaration that the picture includes unidentified people.

mapping.reason: This publication safeguard is local, not a record subject inference.

bindings.definition: The object's own words with language and human review.

mapping.reason: The text and review composite is local; the object remains the cited record.

bindings.definition: A public citation of the family's words, quote language and page or recorded part.

mapping.reason: This is a Citation subset, not a second caption or an invented source.

bindings.definition: Full document text with language and review.

mapping.reason: The transcript text and its review are application data, not an inferred RiC-O relationship.

bindings.definition: Private basis, giver, scope, evidence reference and withdrawal day.

mapping.reason: Permission evidence is private and must not be represented as public creator or holder metadata.

bindings.definition: A retained withdrawal day and closed reason, with no served files.

mapping.reason: Withdrawal is a publication state; it does not delete the cited record.

bindings.definition: A person's reviewed medium and crop region in oriented master pixels.

mapping.reason: This is a presentation selection; it does not change the photograph or its source.

bindings.definition: Family, studio, institution, perpetrator or unknown origin classification.

mapping.reason: A category is not a creator Agent, so made_by must not be asserted as rico:hasCreator.
